stories.summary: Researchers examined the impact of deliberately poisoned training data on anomaly‑detection algorithms used in industrial control systems, testing multiple models under realistic contamination scenarios. The findings reveal that while some detection methods retain high accuracy, others suffer severe performance drops, underscoring the importance of designing more resilient training pipelines.
stories.title: Study Evaluates Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems Against Training‑Time Data Contamination

stories.summary: Researchers introduced Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a novel training framework that enables agents to evaluate and refine their own decisions over extended horizons. Benchmarks demonstrate that SRPO markedly improves performance on complex reasoning tasks compared to previous approaches.
stories.title: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization Enhances Long-Horizon Reasoning in AI Agents

stories.summary: Researchers assess open-source AI models for embodied perception under strict budget constraints, identifying four key resource limitations. The pre-registered evaluation highlights challenges in access-structured perception for smaller-scale systems.
stories.title: Study Evaluates Cost-Effective AI Perception Models Under 31B Parameters

stories.summary: Researchers analyze how AI agents handle inconsistent or incomplete tool outputs, assessing their reliability in real-world scenarios. Findings highlight vulnerabilities and potential improvements for agentic systems.
stories.title: Study Examines Robustness of Agentic AI to Flawed Tool Responses

stories.summary: Researchers introduce a new testing method to improve the reliability of deep reinforcement learning agents by identifying and correcting errors through self-referential comparisons. The approach aims to enhance model robustness and performance in complex environments.
stories.title: Self-Referential Differential Testing Enhances Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents

stories.summary: Researchers introduce a novel evaluation framework using a contextual multidimensional Item Response Theory (IRT) model to assess large language models' performance on previously unseen questions. The approach aims to provide more accurate and nuanced insights into AI capabilities.
stories.title: New Contextual Multidimensional IRT Model Enhances LLM Evaluation on Unseen Questions
FreKoo++: Learning Continuous Spectral Dynamics for Temporal Domain Generalization

stories.summary: A new AI model, KONTOGRAPH, ensures verified feature consistency and amortized explanations for real-time AML decisions within a strict 200 ms latency constraint. The breakthrough enhances fraud detection efficiency in financial transactions.
stories.title: AI System Achieves Real-Time Anti-Money Laundering with 200 ms Decision Budget

stories.summary: Researchers introduce WildHandBench, a challenging benchmark designed to evaluate both AI models and humans on handwritten text comprehension. The tool highlights gaps in current multilingual language models' (MLLMs) performance.
stories.title: WildHandBench: New Benchmark Tests AI and Human Abilities in Handwritten Text Understanding

stories.summary: Meta AI unveiled MetaCaster, an agent that leverages a meta‑harness to perform end‑to‑end few‑shot training of compact time‑series forecasting models, enabling rapid adaptation with minimal data. Benchmarks show the approach outperforms existing lightweight forecasters on standard datasets, highlighting its potential for real‑time forecasting applications.
stories.title: MetaCaster introduces meta‑harness‑optimized agent for few‑shot, end‑to‑end learning of lightweight time‑series forecasters

stories.summary: Researchers introduce a dual-scale state-space model with speaker-wise dynamic CRF to improve speech emotion recognition in conversational settings. The approach aims to better capture emotional cues in multi-speaker interactions.
stories.title: New AI Model Enhances Speech Emotion Recognition in Conversations

stories.summary: A new study demonstrates that aligning large language models with OMOP-based retrieval improves their clinical reasoning abilities across ICU and other medical domains. The approach mimics how physicians process patient data, leading to more accurate and context-aware AI assistance.
stories.title: OMOP-Aligned Retrieval Enhances LLM Clinical Reasoning for ICU Physicians
Joint Causal Structure and Cluster Discovery Using Variational Inference

stories.summary: Researchers introduce A-CPES, a framework designed to standardize the development of agentic AI in cyber-physical energy systems. The approach aims to enhance efficiency and reliability in energy infrastructure management.
stories.title: New Reference Framework Proposed for Agentic AI in Cyber-Physical Energy Systems

stories.summary: A specialized large language model demonstrated strong performance in addressing patient inquiries in psychiatry, highlighting potential for AI in mental health support. The study underscores the model's ability to provide accurate and contextually relevant responses in a clinical setting.
stories.title: Domain-Specific AI Model Shows Promise in Answering Psychiatric Patient Questions

stories.summary: A new spatially validated GeoAI framework identifies building density and vegetation moisture as key drivers of structure loss during the 2025 Palisades Fire. The research highlights how spatial analysis can improve wildfire risk assessment in urban areas.
stories.title: GeoAI Framework Reveals Urban Wildfire Vulnerability Factors in 2025 Palisades Fire

stories.summary: Triplet2Track is a hierarchical AI system leveraging object-centric representations to improve reliability in complex, long-duration robotic tasks. The approach aims to enhance autonomous manipulation in dynamic environments.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce Triplet2Track: A New AI System for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation

stories.summary: Researchers introduce CatchBench, a benchmark designed to assess when and how AI agent failures can be identified. The tool aims to improve reliability and error detection in autonomous AI systems.
stories.title: New Benchmark 'CatchBench' Evaluates AI Agent Failure Detection

stories.summary: A new study examines the challenges of policy variance in AI systems, focusing on critical decision points and local credit assignment mechanisms. The research aims to improve AI model stability and interpretability.
stories.title: AI Research Explores Policy Variance, Critical Forks, and Local Credit Assignment

stories.summary: Apodex 1.1, the latest version of the AI platform, expands its agentic capabilities to autonomously handle multi‑step, complex work across a range of industries. The update adds larger memory buffers, advanced planning modules, and tighter integration tools designed to boost enterprise productivity.
stories.title: Apodex 1.1 Launches to Scale Agentic Intelligence for Complex Tasks

stories.summary: Researchers systematically evaluate lightweight methods to align biomedical texts with knowledge graphs, highlighting efficiency and accuracy trade-offs. The findings aim to improve data integration in biomedical AI applications.
stories.title: Study Compares Lightweight Strategies for Aligning Biomedical Texts and Knowledge Graphs

stories.summary: A new study introduces methods for AI agents to learn generalizable behaviors in terminal environments, improving adaptability across tasks. The work aims to enhance autonomous systems in command-line and text-based interfaces.
stories.title: Researchers Advance AI for Terminal-Based Agent Generalization

stories.summary: Researchers introduce HANSARD, a framework designed to enhance forensic readiness, runtime witnessing, and graded attribution in autonomous multi-agent AI systems. The architecture aims to improve transparency and accountability in complex AI interactions.
stories.title: New Reference Architecture Proposed for Forensic Readiness in Multi-Agent AI Systems

stories.summary: Researchers unveil ParallelWorld, a new method using test-time scaling to enhance reasoning in embodied AI systems. The approach aims to improve adaptability and performance in dynamic environments.
stories.title: ParallelWorld Introduces Test-Time Scaling for Embodied AI Reasoning

stories.summary: Researchers introduce a benchmark to evaluate large language models' capacity for step-level procedural rule reasoning, going beyond factual knowledge. The study highlights gaps in current AI systems' ability to follow multi-step logical processes.
stories.title: New Benchmark Tests AI Models' Procedural Rule Reasoning Abilities

stories.summary: A new framework called DIME enables efficient membership inference attacks on diffusion models, raising concerns about data privacy in AI training. The method reduces query complexity while maintaining high accuracy in identifying training data.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce DIME: A Query-Efficient Framework for Membership Inference Attacks on Diffusion Models
Counterfactual Evaluation of Temporal Observation Protocols

stories.summary: A new study proposes a length-adaptive decoding method to improve masked diffusion models for machine translation, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. The approach dynamically adjusts output length, addressing a key challenge in diffusion-based translation systems.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion in Machine Translation

stories.summary: A new study highlights the 'compaction cliff' phenomenon, where AI agents experience sudden memory degradation over extended operations. The findings underscore challenges in maintaining long-term coherence in autonomous AI systems.
stories.title: Researchers Identify 'Compaction Cliff' in Long-Running AI Agent Memory

stories.summary: A new study introduces InjecMEM, a technique that injects malicious data into the external memory modules of large language model agents, allowing attackers to manipulate the agents' behavior and outputs. The findings expose a critical vulnerability in LLM-powered autonomous systems and call for robust memory‑safety safeguards.
stories.title: Researchers Unveil InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack Targeting LLM Agent Memory Systems

stories.summary: Researchers identify narrative anchoring bias in medical large language models, which may disproportionately influence clinical decision support based on social determinants of health. The findings underscore the need for fairness and trustworthiness in AI-driven healthcare tools.
stories.title: Study Highlights Social Determinants of Health Bias in Medical AI Models

stories.summary: A new study introduces untied self-conditioning to improve the performance of few-step language models, enabling more efficient and accurate text generation. The method addresses limitations in traditional conditioning techniques by decoupling dependencies in the learning process.
stories.title: Researchers Enhance Few-Step Language Models with Untied Self-Conditioning

stories.summary: The finalists of the Apply AI Startup Award have been selected and will present their innovations at a pitching event. The competition highlights emerging AI-driven startups and their potential impact on the industry.
stories.title: Finalists Announced for Apply AI Startup Award Pitching Day

stories.summary: Researchers investigate structural differences in how AI models interpret spoken language compared to written text. The findings aim to bridge gaps in multimodal language understanding.
stories.title: Study Explores How Spoken Language Models Process Speech vs. Text

stories.summary: A new approach called sparse reading enables AI agents to process less text while improving problem-solving efficiency. The method reduces computational costs by focusing on relevant tokens, advancing AI reasoning capabilities.
stories.title: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading Enhances AI Agent Problem-Solving

stories.summary: Meta has unveiled Meta-Moderator, a system designed to enhance multi-agent AI debates through meta-cognitive capabilities. The technology aims to improve reasoning and consensus-building among AI agents.
stories.title: Meta Introduces Meta-Moderator for Multi-Agent AI Debate with Meta-Cognition

stories.summary: A new study evaluates the practical application of an AI-assisted system (CAIA) in text-based online counseling. The research assesses its effectiveness and impact on support quality.
stories.title: Field Evaluation of AI-Assisted Support System for Online Text-Based Counseling

stories.summary: ProBel unveils a new AI-driven system for detecting propaganda by analyzing linguistic spans and providing transparent explanations. The approach aims to improve accuracy and interpretability in identifying misleading content.
stories.title: ProBel Introduces Advanced Propaganda Detection with Explainable AI Techniques

stories.summary: A new AI model, Object-Uni, has been developed to unify object-centric spatial reasoning and controllable generation, advancing capabilities in scene understanding and manipulation. The approach integrates spatial and semantic awareness to improve performance in complex visual tasks.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce Object-Uni: A Unified AI Model for Object-Centric Spatial Understanding and Generation

stories.summary: A new study assesses the capabilities and limitations of AI agents in web development tasks, distinguishing between meaningful performance and mere noise. The findings aim to clarify the practical utility of current AI tools in this domain.
stories.title: Benchmark Study Evaluates AI Agent Skills in Web Development

stories.summary: A new study introduces a framework to improve the reliability of AI agents' skills when operating in collaborative, multi-agent environments. The approach aims to enhance coordination and adaptability in dynamic, self-evolving systems.
stories.title: Researchers Advance Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability in Self-Evolving AI Agents

stories.summary: A new study exposes vulnerabilities in multimodal large language models, demonstrating how they can be misled by situational illusions. The findings highlight the need for improved robustness in AI systems processing visual and textual inputs.
stories.title: Researchers Unveil Situational Illusions Affecting Multimodal AI Models

stories.summary: A new approach called Calibrated Residual Decoding enables personalized adjustments to vision-language models without additional training. The method aims to improve efficiency and accessibility in customizing AI models for specific tasks.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce Training-Free Method for Personalizing Vision-Language Models

stories.summary: Researchers investigate when and how spatial encodings in vision-language models lead to correct answers, highlighting gaps between internal knowledge and output. The findings shed light on the decision-making processes of AI systems in visual and linguistic tasks.
stories.title: Study Explores How Vision-Language Models Process Spatial Reasoning

stories.summary: A new study uses graph-based methods to evaluate how humans and large language models approach scientific fact-checking, revealing differences in reasoning processes. The findings highlight strengths and limitations of AI in verifying complex information.
stories.title: Graph-Based Analysis Compares Human and LLM Reasoning in Scientific Fact-Checking

stories.summary: Researchers propose a new framework to integrate video reasoning and deep research capabilities, enabling AI agents to operate more effectively in open-world environments. The approach aims to bridge gaps between visual understanding and complex decision-making.
stories.title: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Advanced Open-World AI Agents

stories.summary: Researchers propose a technique to reduce textual overhead in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) without losing critical visual context. The approach aims to improve efficiency in AI agents handling complex, real-world tasks.
stories.title: New Method Addresses Context Pruning in Multimodal AI While Preserving Visual Evidence

stories.summary: A new study shows that adjusting erroneous physical invariants learned by AI models significantly enhances the accuracy of their world-model rollouts. By enforcing correct conservation laws, the approach leads to more reliable predictions in simulation-based tasks.
stories.title: Researchers Boost AI World-Model Simulations by Fixing Learned Physical Invariants

stories.summary: Researchers introduce methods to improve deep research AI agents by isolating and mitigating noise in data processing. The approach aims to boost objectivity and accuracy in automated analysis.
stories.title: Enhancing AI Research Agents Through Noise Isolation Techniques

stories.summary: Researchers analyze how LLMs tailor teaching methods in educational interactions, revealing patterns in adaptive learning. Findings highlight potential for personalized AI-driven tutoring systems.
stories.title: Study Examines How Large Language Models Adapt Pedagogical Strategies in AI Tutoring
